label: Auto-update
intent: The update installs by itself. Light: the ring runs one clockwise cycle on its own, and as it comes round the download arrow pulls back and plunges into place with a hit, rebounds a little and settles. Strong: the ring winds back before it whips round, overshoots and settles, and the arrow pulls back further and plunges harder with a two-beat settle. An invisible step returns the ring from 360 to 0.

cycle.//: the ring and its arrowhead turn together about the centre

arrow.y.//: the arrow follows the ring: it pulls back while the ring runs and lands as the ring comes round
